method: Manual review of live exact-head GitHub merge and workflow metadata, exact PR diffs, current DRModels.jl PR/check/owner-comment state and raw CI versions, plus read-only SHA-256 comparison of the receipt against exact pre-merge and merge R source trees; followed by closeout and prose validators.
coverage: Whole report by continuity from v15; reread the #1662 receipt baseline attribution section (latest dated section) and its exact commit/tree comparison evidence through 2026-11-02 12:02 UTC.
score_reason: The report uses exact files, SHAs, run IDs, and explicit limits. Some technical sentences are dense, but the PR status is separated into short bullets.
confidence_reason: Merge metadata and workflow logs were read live. The receipt hash comparison used archived R trees at exact base and merge commits, and confirmed the receipt JSON is identical between them. The #1237 exact-head Julia version came from its raw workflow log. Other receipt refs and lane ownership were read with preflight; style review remains self-assessed and uncalibrated.

science_gate_reason: This report records a documentation reconciliation, not a new scientific result.
facts_gate_reason: The merge commit and timestamp, post-merge workflow, #1245 and #1237 exact-head checks, and #1237 raw Julia version log were verified from live GitHub. Read-only SHA-256 comparison of archived R trees at the exact PR base and merge commits yielded identical mismatch and unrecorded-file counts; the receipt JSON is byte-identical across those commits. Lane preflight found 12 other refs with receipt edits. No PR, source, or receipt was altered.
references_gate_reason: The new PR and workflow links point to the records checked during this refresh; prior unresolved capability citations remain explicitly listed as residuals.
calibration_status: No style controls were used; this is an uncalibrated editorial judgment.
